measurement_note: Size is the query count Q. Each tier starts from nums = [1], inserts Q distinct pseudo-random values, and requests varying legal ranks. The accepted compression/Fenwick method takes O(Q log Q) time here; re-sorting the entire unsorted insertion history for every order statistic takes O(Q^2 log Q).
